backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (UserProfile, ExpenseEntry, PermissionRequest, Message, StudyMaterial, etc.) and including authorization and blob storage mixins for a family management and educational platform.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping five deployment and build error investigation features to their relevant frontend files, components, and test requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React files describing components, pages, hooks, and configurations for the FamilyConnect application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes, defining a warm family-friendly color palette with oranges and soft tones.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, theme color configuration, manifest link, and apple touch icon references for mobile web app capabilities.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, theme colors, and display settings for FamilyConnect as a standalone mobile application.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first for API calls, with cache management and offline fallback support.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component with TanStack Router, ProfileSetupModal for role selection, automatic invitation token processing from URL parameters, and navigation to dashboard after profile creation.
frontend/src/components/AIConflictAnalys: React component that provides AI-powered family conflict detection and remedy suggestions with a toggle to enable/disable analysis and displays mock conflict data with descriptions and remedies.
Displays study tips, performance insights with AI analysis levels, and IC technology tips fetched from backend queries in separate card sections with loading states.
frontend/src/components/ChatWidget.tsx: Draggable floating chat widget for family group messaging with real-time message display, send functionality, and authentication-gated access.
frontend/src/components/DoubtClearingInt: Interface for students to ask educational questions and receive AI-generated answers, displaying conversation history with timestamps and a mark-resolved feature.
Analyzes weekly expenses across fees, groceries, and other categories, generating personalized insights and recommendations based on spending patterns and percentages.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseChart.tsx: Visualizes weekly expenses as horizontal bar charts showing fees, groceries, and other spending with percentages and a total summary.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseInput.tsx: Form component for parents to add expenses with category selection (fees, groceries, other) and amount input, using React Query mutations and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/FightsCreatedWid: Card widget displaying the count of family conflicts created, with inline editing capability to manually update the counter value.
frontend/src/components/FightsSolvedWidg: Card widget showing the count of resolved family conflicts, with inline editing functionality to manually adjust the counter.
frontend/src/components/HappinessMeter.t: Displays a visual happiness score (0-100%) with color-coded icons and progress bar based on family communications and interactions.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper providing header with authentication, navigation menu, share functionality, chat widget, and onboarding guidance tooltips.
frontend/src/components/PermissionApprov: Parent-facing component to view and approve/deny pending permission requests from children with request details and action buttons.
frontend/src/components/PermissionReques: Child-facing form to request permissions for activities (go out, play games, watch YouTube) by selecting activity type, entering reason, and specifying parent principal ID.
frontend/src/components/ProblemsSolvedWi: Displays a card widget showing the total count of resolved educational problems/doubts, with a trophy icon and loading state.
frontend/src/components/ShareApp.tsx: Dialog component for inviting family members via a shareable link, with copy-to-clipboard functionality and onboarding instructions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatWidget.ts: Manages chat widget state (open/closed and position) with localStorage persistence for user preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout, managing identity state and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboarding.ts: Manages multi-step onboarding state with localStorage persistence, tracking completion of role selection, family connections, and UI guidance steps.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend API calls including user profiles, family connections, expenses, messages, educational data, and location tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom warm color palette and design tokens for light/dark themes, optimized for family-friendly UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx: Chat page component supporting group and private messaging with text, grocery lists, and social media links. Includes AI conflict analysis, message type selection, and family member recipient selection for private chats.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying family metrics including happiness meter, problems/fights solved, permission requests, expense tracking, and onboarding guidance for parents and children. Shows different widgets based on user role (parent/child).
frontend/src/pages/EducationalHub.tsx: Educational hub page with tabs for uploading question papers and answer scripts, viewing materials, AI analysis results, and a doubt-clearing interface. Tracks upload progress and manages educational data.
frontend/src/pages/LocationSharing.tsx: Location sharing page that allows users to share their current GPS coordinates with family members and view family locations. Uses browser geolocation API and displays coordinates with privacy notice.
frontend/src/pages/MediaGallery.tsx: Media gallery page for uploading and viewing family photos and videos with descriptions. Supports file upload with progress tracking, displays media with timestamps and uploader names.
frontend/src/pages/Reminders.tsx: React component for creating and displaying family reminders with due dates, status indicators (overdue/due soon/upcoming), and authentication-gated access.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page component handling user profile updates, family invitation generation/management, and account deletion with role-based features for parents.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for managing URL hash parameters, specifically for handling invitation tokens and secret parameters in the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes (warm palette, oklch colors), typography, animations, and design tokens for the family app theme.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking architectural decisions, known issues (role selection, empty dashboard, build errors), existing features (dashboard, reminders, chat, happiness meter), and AI integration requirements for a family communication app.
